papers.title: Towards full-stack functionalist theories of consciousness: Identifying the functional profile
papers.reason: The paper is primarily about consciousness, but its functional-profile approach and discussion of attentional control, metacognition, and process architectures are relevant to computational modelling of executive cognition.

papers.title: Octopus: One Brain, Many Branches for Latent-KV Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.reason: The paper concerns KV caching, recurrent model memory, and reinforcement learning for AI agents rather than human or animal cognition.

papers.title: Reduced magnocellular-biased visual responses are associated with working memory and linguistic difficulties in Chinese developmental dyslexia: A hypothesized visual-cognitive cascade.
papers.reason: The study reports EEG and behavioural findings linking early visual cortical processing, verbal working memory, visuospatial attention, and developmental dyslexia, with clear relevance to modelling cognitive cascades in executive function.

papers.title: Seeing Without Seeing: A Methodological Review of Visual Mental Imagery Reconstruction from Brain Activity
papers.reason: The review concerns neural decoding of visual imagery and only tangentially overlaps with executive-function modelling through working-memory maintenance and top-down imagery mechanisms.

papers.title: Structural changes in the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex following a randomized clinical trial of virtual reality-based cognitive remediation in mood and schizophrenia spectrum disorders.
papers.reason: The paper links cognitive remediation in clinical populations to structural changes in prefrontal cortex, but the cognitive outcomes are broad and not specifically modelled as executive-function processes.
